metas.name: Bicol Adidas Guardrails
metas.note: In an area including Bicol and Masbate, you will see guardrails marked with three black stripes. Careful: you can get more or fewer than three in other places as well, but if you see three, it is most likely going to be this area.
metas.footer: Check out sleepfor8hx3's Philippines Guide for more info

metas.name: Bohol Thick Insulator Stem
metas.note: The stems on which insulators sit at the top of poles is commonly encased in a plastic tube that makes it appear much thicker than usual on the island of Bohol.
metas.footer: Check out sleepfor8hx3's Philippines Guide for more info

metas.name: Bottom Half Motorcycle Plates
metas.note: If a motorcycle plate has a colorful stripe on the bottom, you are in the bottom half of the country.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/philippines.

metas.name: Cordillera Yellow/Black Guardrails
metas.note: In the Cordillera Administrative Region you can find yellow and black striped concrete guardrails.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/philippines.

metas.name: Corn
metas.note: While corn can be found in most of the country, it is most common on northern Luzon and on Mindanao.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/philippines.

metas.name: Cotabato/Davao Umbrella Tuk-Tuk
metas.note: Tuk-Tuks with a black umbrella will be found mostly in Cotabato and sometimes Davao
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/philippines.

metas.name: Crown Roof Tuk-Tuk
metas.note: Tuk-Tuks with a crown roof can be found mostly in Northern Luzon. The crown consists of two separate parts, a "rectangular" part and a "crown-shaped" part. Some Tuk-Tuks elsewhere will have a wavy top, but are not made of two parts and thus are not crowns.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/philippines.

metas.name: Davao Occidental Quad Pancake Insulator
metas.note: If you see a quadruple pancake insulator on a pole top, you're going to be on the one road with coverage in Davao Occidental, along the coast, between approximately Don Marcelino and Bukid.
metas.footer: Check out vaivod and brikiiee's Philippines Pole Doc for more info

metas.name: East Samar Double Pancake Insulator
metas.note: Double pancake insulators are very rare, but most likely to be found along the coast of East Samar, from about the height of the island of Hilabaan all the way down to the southern tip.
metas.footer: Check out vaivod and brikiiee's Philippines Pole Doc for more info

metas.name: Flat Roof Tuk-Tuk
metas.note: Flat roofs are mostly found in the south. If it's a three-wheeler (as seen on the leftmost), you're probably on Mindanao.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/philippines.

metas.name: Ilocos Norte and Biliran Quad Insulator
metas.note: This cylinder with four distinct ridges is most common in Ilocos Norte, but can also be found in Biliran.
metas.footer: Check out vaivod and brikiiee's Philippines Pole Doc for more info

metas.name: Low Roof Tuk-Tuks
metas.note: Low roof Tuk-Tuks are generally found in the North.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/philippines.

metas.name: Manila and Ilocos Norte Star Wars Insulator
metas.note: This type of insulator that looks like the buildings on Tatooine is most common in northern Luzon and in and around Manila.
metas.footer: Check out vaivod and brikiiee's Philippines Pole Doc for more info

metas.name: Manila Sausage Insulator
metas.note: This grey insulator with lots of small ridges that looks kind of solid is most common in and around Manila, but can rarely be found elsewhere.
metas.footer: Check out vaivod and brikiiee's Philippines Pole Doc for more info

metas.name: Mesh poles
metas.note: Flimsy mesh poles are common in the province of Zamboanga Sibugay. They also, rarely, appear in other provinces, but even then you should be on Mindanao.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/philippines.

metas.name: Mindanao Oil Palm Plantations
metas.note: The vast majority of Oil palm plantations are found on Mindanao.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/philippines.

metas.name: Mindanao Pineapple Plantations
metas.note: Pineapple plantations are mostly found on Mindanao.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/philippines.

metas.name: Negros/Panay Sugarcane
metas.note: The majority of sugarcane in the Philippines can be found on the islands of Negros and Panay.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/philippines.

metas.name: North Cebu Yellow Blocks
metas.note: In northern Cebu, you will find gray concrete guard blocks with their edges painted yellow.
metas.footer: Check out sleepfor8hx3's Philippines Guide for more info

metas.name: North Luzon Chile Poles
metas.note: Chile poles can be frequently found in northern Luzon, especially Cagayan, but careful - they can also appear, if less commonly, in northern Negros!
metas.footer: Check out vaivod and brikiiee's Philippines Pole Doc for more info

metas.name: North Luzon Mountain Dew Decorations
metas.note: If you ever find Mountain Dew bottle decorations, you're probably in Northern Luzon.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/philippines.

metas.name: Northern Luzon Dry + Pines
metas.note: The forested mountain range in Northern Luzon is characterised by somewhat dry mountainsides and an abundance of pine trees. You may rarely come across a similar landscape on high-altitude roads in Mindanao.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/philippines.

metas.name: Northwest Leyte and Biliran Insulators
metas.note: Three ridges plus a long extender at the top to carry the wire are most commonly found in Leyte and Biliran.
metas.footer: Check out vaivod and brikiiee's Philippines Pole Doc for more info

metas.name: Palawan Diagonal Amakan Pattern
metas.note: Houses built with amakan walls (referred to as Sawali in the north) with a diagonally woven pattern are mostly found on the island of Palawan, but can also be found throughout the northern half of the country.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/philippines.

metas.name: Palawan Tuk-Tuk
metas.note: This Tuk-Tuk with a single front window and flat roof is exclusive to Palawan.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/philippines.

metas.name: Panay and Guimaras Yellow Backboards
metas.note: On the islands of Panay and Guimaras (the little island next to Iloilo), electricity counters are frequently mounted on yellow backboards. These can be horizontal or vertical, metal or wood.
metas.footer: Check out sleepfor8hx3's Philippines Guide for more info

metas.name: Quezon Blue/Red Blocks
metas.note: In a small area on the isthmus of Quezon province, you will find alternating red and blue guard blocks.
metas.footer: Check out sleepfor8hx3's Philippines Guide for more info

metas.name: South Mindanao Car
metas.note: On few roads in Southern Mindanao, in the very South of the Philippines, there is some footage taken with a silver truck with a visible roof rack
metas.footer: Check out sleepfor8hx3's Philippines Guide for more info

metas.name: Southern Diamond Amakan Pattern
metas.note: Houses built with amakan walls, a traditionally woven bamboo mat, with a diamond pattern are almost exclusively found in the southern half of the country.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/philippines.

metas.name: Southern Mindanao Bananas
metas.note: Banana plantations are most common on Mindanao. Beware: wild bananas can be found everywhere. Make sure it is a plantation.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/philippines.

metas.name: Southern Quezon Acne Blocks
metas.note: The southern peninsula of Quezon has these sloped concrete blocks with round spots made from small rocks that kind of look like a skin issue. Blocks in this style with straight edges are common throughout the country, and you can get slanted concrete blocks without the acne in other places as well, but the combination is exclusive to this area.
metas.footer: Check out sleepfor8hx3's Philippines Guide for more info

metas.name: Top Half Motorcycle Plates
metas.note: If a motorcycle has a colorful stripe on the top, you are in the top half of the country.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/philippines.

metas.name: Western Mindanao Muslim
metas.note: While most of the Philippines is strongly christian, a region of western Mindanao is majority muslim.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/philippines.
